none: PAS FindID 1016395: Roman coin: radiate, possibly commemorative for Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, later Roman issue of 260-275, possibly commemorative for Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13, with an especially shoddy reverse. Obverse description: Radiate bust long neck and bare shouldered. Reverse description: crudely depicted altar subdivided by cross, sacrificial implements on altar. Reverse inscription: PNTI[-]. Diameter: 16.7mm, Weight: 1.45gms, die axis: 6
